summary.en: When the make-up of your household changes, for example you start living together after marriage, file a household head change, merger or separation notice with the ward office within 14 days of the change (to be checked). Merger and separation notices must be filed at the counter; mail is not accepted. If your address changes, the move notification is also due within 14 days (to be checked).
